description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles have benched QB Tanner McKee.
items.impact: McKee continued to struggle in last Sunday's loss against the Commanders. Joe Milton III will start in Week 9 against the Giants.
items.title: Tanner McKee benched by Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles are starting Joe Milton III at quarterback on Sunday against the Giants.
items.impact: The Eagles have made the decision to bench Tanner McKee. Milton will be a desperate QB2 play for fantasy managers in 2-QB and superflex leagues.
items.title: Joe Milton III to start in Week 9 for Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: David Montgomery is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Montgomery remains uncertain for Week 9 against the Chargers.
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Reed Blankenship is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Blankenship's status remains uncertain for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.title: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Blake Fisher practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Fisher practices to begin the week as expected. He could be good to go for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.title: Blake Fisher (thumb) practices Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalen Pitre was back practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pitre is working his way back from an AC shoulder joint sprain. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign.
items.title: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) practices Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sam Darnold has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals due to a quad injury.
items.impact: Darnold suffered a quad injury in Monday's loss against the Bears. Drew Lock will get the start in his place on Sunday.
items.title: Sam Darnold (quad) ruled out for Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks will start Drew Lock on Sunday against the Cardinals following a quad injury for Sam Darnold.
items.impact: Darnold suffered a quad injury in Monday's loss against the Bears. Lock will be getting his second start against Arizona this season.
items.title: Drew Lock to start for Seahawks in Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Watson is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Watson left last Thursday's game early before eventually returning later in the game. He is on track to be good to go this week.
items.title: Christian Watson (rib) practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers designated RB Chris Brooks to return to practice.
items.impact: Brooks was back on the field during practice on Wednesday. He has been on injured reserve for the past few weeks.
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) designated to return to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cam Skattebo was working on the side with a trainer during practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is another absence from practice for Skattebo. His status for Week 9 is up in the air.
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) working on side with trainer Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Harold Landry is working hard to return.
items.impact: Landry has been on the PUP list since the start of September. He remains uncertain to return anytime soon.
items.title: Harold Landry III (knee) working hard to return

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Greg Van Roten will return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Van Roten's status remains up in the air for Week 9 against the Packers.
items.title: Greg Van Roten will practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Barmore is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Barmore will be sidelined from practice to begin the week due to an illness.
items.title: Christian Barmore (illness) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Henderson did not play last week. He will need to continue to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: A.J. Brown is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brown was hopeful to practice this week. He will need to be monitored on Thursday and Friday.
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) will not practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said David Bailey will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bailey will be limited in practice to begin the week.
items.title: David Bailey (ankle) to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Quincy Williams is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams will be sidelined with a hamstring injury. His status for Week 9 against the Saints is up in the air.
items.title: Quincy Williams (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Maliek Collins is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Collins will be sidelined with an elbow injury. His status for Week 9 against the Saints is up in the air.
items.title: Maliek Collins (elbow) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Zaire Franklin will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: LaFleur said Franklin is "making a lot of progress." His status remains unclear the rest of the week.
items.title: Zaire Franklin (leg) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Daron Payne will likely be out for the season.
items.impact: Payne was placed on injured reserve on Tuesday.
items.title: Daron Payne likely out for season

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Jeremy McNichols will likely be out for the season.
items.impact: McNichols was placed on injured reserve on Tuesday.
items.title: Jeremy McNichols likely out for season

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kadyn Proctor will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Proctor remains in concussion protocol. His status remains uncertain heading into this week.
items.title: Kadyn Proctor (concussion) to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Javon Kinlaw underwent surgery on Tuesday.
items.impact: Kinlaw got injured on October 19. He underwent additional testing that led to undergoing surgery this week. He will be sidelined indefinitely.
items.title: Javon Kinlaw (knee) undergoes surgery

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ezra Cleveland is expected to play on Thursday against the Ravens.
items.impact: Cleveland is dealing with knee and ankle injuries. He should be good to go on Thursday.
items.title: Ezra Cleveland (knee/ankle) expected to play Thursday
